stance_rationale: The package is draft-only and fails Forge verification because the required WT-H20260512_001 weights, stage artifacts, 3-agent packages, hash audit, returns, charts, Harvey/DSR outputs, and covariance evidence are absent. No approval-grade claim can be made from planned formulas and TBD fields.

critical_concerns.description: Required WT artifacts are missing: weights.csv, WT_H20260512_001 stage dirs, monthly_returns, charts, alpha/risk/optimization packages, and challenge notes are not present, so Forge cannot verify execution rather than intent.
Pure Function v6.1 R12 audit is not evidenced: source_md5_pre/post are TBD and the three package md5 start/end hashes are absent.
Walk-forward schedule is unverified because weights.csv is absent, n_sig_dates is zero, and no monthly_returns.parquet date range exists; this leaves the Iter 4 single-snapshot failure mode open.
Lockbox and OOS visibility cannot be verified: no equity_curve.png or oos_zoom_chart.png exists, and there is no evidence of frozen buy-and-hold extension after 2024-01-23.
Baseline comparison is still documented-baseline based: the package cites admit/production lineage values but provides no same-period, same-cost, same-DSR-penalty recomputation.
Harvey 5-spec and DSR are declared as gates but not produced; CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 t_NW, alpha_monthly, DSR, and baseline penalty are absent.
Cost and turnover wording is ambiguous: the package says commission is 15bps each side but also says 15bps round-trip on turnover, with no verified round-trip x2 annual turnover calculation.
The liquidity step includes 'fallback no-filter if <5 names', which is a silent override of the mandatory 20d trade-value floor and weakens the C10 liquidity lag constraint.
Defense-amplifier variants are proposed without AX-001 conditional defense evidence: crisis_alpha, Core-relative MDD relief, and bad/normal IC ratio are not shown.
covariance.parquet is absent at the requested WT path, so PSD status and post-shrink condition number <=100 are unverified.

supporting_arguments: The upstream source alpha_scores.parquet cited by the draft exists and has 79,835 rows, 268 monthly dates from 2004-01-01 to 2026-04-01, and the needed score_core_z/score_defense_z/regime_state columns.
The two cited upstream alpha source paths currently share the same md5, but the draft does not record that equivalence in its own hash audit.
No exact auto-flag rationalization phrases from the base list were detected.
unresolved_disputes: Whether generated weights cover at least 60 monthly sig_dates and satisfy max_names, long-only, weight bounds, and sum-to-one.
Whether monthly_returns covers the intended 2005-02 to 2026-04 period and separates pre-lockbox, lockbox, and combined results.
Whether same-period baseline was recomputed under identical cost and DSR penalty rather than cited from prior documentation.
Whether covariance is PSD with post-shrink condition number <=100.
Whether the liquidity fallback is removed or converted into an explicit infeasibility report.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is schedule_fidelity_pre_certify: it asserts per-variant weights.csv will be generated and used as-is, but no WT-H20260512_001 weights.csv or returns artifact exists to prove walk-forward execution.
rebuttal_required: Produce alpha/risk/optimization packages plus challenge notes for WT-H20260512_001.
Provide PRE/POST md5 hash_audit for all three immutable packages and alpha/cov/weights artifacts.
Provide weights.csv with as_of_date count, monthly_returns.parquet date range, and hard-constraint checks.
Provide equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, oos_zoom_chart.png, and lockbox frozen-extension evidence.
Provide same-period baseline recomputation with identical costs and DSR penalty.
Provide complete CAPM/C3/C4/FF5/FF6 Harvey t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR outputs.
Provide covariance PSD and condition-number audit.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Current evidence is a design draft, not a Forge verification package; 2-source PASS is impossible until artifacts and independent checks exist.
